headline: Coalition Intercepts Houthi Drones and Missile Targeting Riyadh's Financial District
summary: Saudi air defense forces intercepted five drones and a ballistic missile launched by Houthi forces targeting King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh. Pakistan condemned the civilian targeting while civil defense issued warnings in southern regions.
why: King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh is Saudi Arabia's major commercial and banking hub. Middle Eastern stability impacts global energy trade.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Targeted missile strikes on commercial districts elevate geopolitical risk premiums.
